shapeSummary: Simplified 28-tooth bevel hub gear: a 42 mm diameter, 6.5 mm thick disc with its axis along X, centered at X=0 and Z=0 with its bottom at Y=0. It has a 16 mm through bore and 28 radial rectangular slots around the rim forming straight teeth. The mating pinion is not modeled.
warnings: Dimensions (42 mm OD, 6.5 mm thickness, 16 mm bore) are estimates scaled from the image and drawing notes, not verified.
Teeth are simplified as straight rectangular slots cut through the rim, with no bevel or conical tooth geometry or tooth profile.
The ring of smaller lightening/mounting holes is omitted because its diameter and positions are uncertain.
The 14-tooth pinion with its clamp hub, 8 mm REX bore, clamp screws and threads is not modeled.
The 28-tooth gear is modeled as a single part, so the set is not an assembly.

r=21.0
t=6.5
cy=21.0
part=cq.Workplane('YZ').center(cy,0).circle(r).extrude(t/2,both=True)
part=part.cut(cq.Workplane('YZ').center(cy,0).circle(8).extrude(t,both=True))

    part=part.cut(slot)
